description: This Kotlin source file defines the CameraHandler class which manages camera-related functionalities for an Android application, including listing devices, capturing photos, recording clips, and handling associated UI feedback and error management.

classes.name: CameraHandler
classes.description: A class responsible for handling camera operations such as listing devices, snapping photos, recording clips, and handling related UI updates and error conditions in an Android environment.

methods.name: handleList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of camera devices and returns it as a JSON payload wrapped in a GatewaySession invocation result.

methods.name: handleSnap
methods.description: Captures a photo with the camera, manages UI indicators, logs progress, handles errors, and returns the photo payload encoded in JSON.

methods.name: handleClip
methods.description: Records a video clip, handles payload size checks, manages UI feedback, logs progress, handles errors, and returns the clip data encoded in base64 within a JSON structure.

methods.name: parseIncludeAudio
methods.description: Parses the 'includeAudio' parameter from a JSON string to determine if audio should be included during recording.
